en.text: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

zhSimplified.text: 我与眼睛立约， 怎能恋恋瞻望处女呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我與眼睛立約， 怎能戀戀瞻望處女呢？

en.text: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

zhSimplified.text: 从至上的 神所得之分， 从至高全能者所得之业是什么呢？

zhTraditional.text: 從至上的上帝所得之分， 從至高全能者所得之業是甚麼呢？

en.text: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

zhSimplified.text: 岂不是祸患临到不义的， 灾害临到作孽的呢？

zhTraditional.text: 豈不是禍患臨到不義的， 災害臨到作孽的呢？

en.text: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

zhSimplified.text: 神岂不是察看我的道路， 数点我的脚步呢？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝豈不是察看我的道路， 數點我的腳步呢？

en.text: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

zhSimplified.text: 我若与虚谎同行， 脚若追随诡诈； （

zhTraditional.text: 我若與虛謊同行， 腳若追隨詭詐； （

en.text: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

zhSimplified.text: 我若被公道的天平称度， 使 神可以知道我的纯正；）

zhTraditional.text: 我若被公道的天平稱度， 使上帝可以知道我的純正；）

en.text: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

zhSimplified.text: 我的脚步若偏离正路， 我的心若随着我的眼目， 若有玷污粘在我手上；

zhTraditional.text: 我的腳步若偏離正路， 我的心若隨着我的眼目， 若有玷污粘在我手上；

en.text: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

zhSimplified.text: 就愿我所种的有别人吃， 我田所产的被拔出来。

zhTraditional.text: 就願我所種的有別人吃， 我田所產的被拔出來。

en.text: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

zhSimplified.text: 我若受迷惑，向妇人起淫念， 在邻舍的门外蹲伏，

zhTraditional.text: 我若受迷惑，向婦人起淫念， 在鄰舍的門外蹲伏，

en.text: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

zhSimplified.text: 就愿我的妻子给别人推磨， 别人也与她同室。

zhTraditional.text: 就願我的妻子給別人推磨， 別人也與她同室。

en.text: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

zhSimplified.text: 因为这是大罪， 是审判官当罚的罪孽。

zhTraditional.text: 因為這是大罪， 是審判官當罰的罪孽。

en.text: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

zhSimplified.text: 这本是火焚烧，直到毁灭， 必拔除我所有的家产。

zhTraditional.text: 這本是火焚燒，直到毀滅， 必拔除我所有的家產。

en.text: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

zhSimplified.text: 我的仆婢与我争辩的时候， 我若藐视不听他们的情节；

zhTraditional.text: 我的僕婢與我爭辯的時候， 我若藐視不聽他們的情節；

en.text: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

zhSimplified.text: 神兴起，我怎样行呢？ 他察问，我怎样回答呢？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝興起，我怎樣行呢？ 他察問，我怎樣回答呢？

en.text: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

zhSimplified.text: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他吗？ 将他与我抟在腹中的岂不是一位吗？

zhTraditional.text: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他嗎？ 將他與我摶在腹中的豈不是一位嗎？

en.text: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

zhSimplified.text: 我若不容贫寒人得其所愿， 或叫寡妇眼中失望，

zhTraditional.text: 我若不容貧寒人得其所願， 或叫寡婦眼中失望，

en.text: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

zhSimplified.text: 或独自吃我一点食物， 孤儿没有与我同吃； （

zhTraditional.text: 或獨自吃我一點食物， 孤兒沒有與我同吃； （

en.text: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

zhSimplified.text: 从幼年时孤儿与我同长，好像父子一样； 我从出母腹就扶助寡妇。）

zhTraditional.text: 從幼年時孤兒與我同長，好像父子一樣； 我從出母腹就扶助 寡婦。）

en.text: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

zhSimplified.text: 我若见人因无衣死亡， 或见穷乏人身无遮盖；

zhTraditional.text: 我若見人因無衣死亡， 或見窮乏人身無遮蓋；

en.text: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

zhSimplified.text: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖， 为我祝福；

zhTraditional.text: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖， 為我祝福；

en.text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

zhSimplified.text: 我若在城门口见有帮助我的， 举手攻击孤儿；

zhTraditional.text: 我若在城門口見有幫助我的， 舉手攻擊孤兒；

en.text: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

zhSimplified.text: 情愿我的肩头从缺盆骨脱落， 我的膀臂从羊矢骨折断。

zhTraditional.text: 情願我的肩頭從缺盆骨脫落， 我的膀臂從羊矢骨折斷。

en.text: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 因 神降的灾祸使我恐惧； 因他的威严，我不能妄为。

zhTraditional.text: 因上帝降的災禍使我恐懼； 因他的威嚴，我不能妄為。

en.text: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

zhSimplified.text: 我若以黄金为指望， 对精金说：你是我的倚靠；

zhTraditional.text: 我若以黃金為指望， 對精金說：你是我的倚靠；

en.text: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

zhSimplified.text: 我若因财物丰裕， 因我手多得资财而欢喜；

zhTraditional.text: 我若因財物豐裕， 因我手多得資財而歡喜；

en.text: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

zhSimplified.text: 我若见太阳发光， 明月行在空中，

zhTraditional.text: 我若見太陽發光， 明月行在空中，

en.text: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

zhSimplified.text: 心就暗暗被引诱， 口便亲手；

zhTraditional.text: 心就暗暗被引誘， 口便親手；

en.text: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

zhSimplified.text: 这也是审判官当罚的罪孽， 又是我背弃在上的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 這也是審判官當罰的罪孽， 又是我背棄在上的上帝。

en.text: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

zhSimplified.text: 我若见恨我的遭报就欢喜， 见他遭灾便高兴； （

zhTraditional.text: 我若見恨我的遭報就歡喜， 見他遭災便高興； （

en.text: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

zhSimplified.text: 我没有容口犯罪， 咒诅他的生命；）

zhTraditional.text: 我沒有容口犯罪， 咒詛他的生命；）

en.text: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

zhSimplified.text: 若我帐棚的人未尝说， 谁不以主人的食物吃饱呢？ （

zhTraditional.text: 若我帳棚的人未嘗說， 誰不以主人的食物吃飽呢？ （

en.text: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

zhSimplified.text: 从来我没有容客旅在街上住宿， 却开门迎接行路的人；）

zhTraditional.text: 從來我沒有容客旅在街上住宿， 卻開門迎接行路的人；）

en.text: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

zhSimplified.text: 我若像亚当遮掩我的过犯， 将罪孽藏在怀中；

zhTraditional.text: 我若像亞當遮掩我的過犯， 將罪孽藏在懷中；

en.text: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

zhSimplified.text: 因惧怕大众， 又因宗族藐视我使我惊恐， 以致闭口无言，杜门不出；

zhTraditional.text: 因懼怕大眾， 又因宗族藐視我使我驚恐， 以致閉口無言，杜門不出；

en.text: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

zhSimplified.text: 惟愿有一位肯听我！ （看哪，在这里有我所划的押， 愿全能者回答我！）

zhTraditional.text: 惟願有一位肯聽我！ （看哪，在這裏有我所劃的押， 願全能者回答我！）

en.text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那敌我者所写的状词在我这里！ 我必带在肩上，又绑在头上为冠冕。

zhTraditional.text: 願那敵我者所寫的狀詞在我這裏！ 我必帶在肩上，又綁在頭上為冠冕。

en.text: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

zhSimplified.text: 我必向他述说我脚步的数目， 必如君王进到他面前。

zhTraditional.text: 我必向他述說我腳步的數目， 必如君王進到他面前。

en.text: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

zhSimplified.text: 我若夺取田地，这地向我喊冤， 犁沟一同哭泣；

zhTraditional.text: 我若奪取田地，這地向我喊冤， 犂溝一同哭泣；

en.text: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

zhSimplified.text: 我若吃地的出产不给价值， 或叫原主丧命；

zhTraditional.text: 我若吃地的出產不給價值， 或叫原主喪命；

en.text: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

zhSimplified.text: 愿这地长蒺藜代替麦子， 长恶草代替大麦。 约伯的话说完了。

zhTraditional.text: 願這地長蒺藜代替麥子， 長惡草代替大麥。 約伯的話說完了。
